title: How AI will reshape work: Anthropic identifies the most exposed jobs | Euronews
summary: Anthropic's report shows high theoretical AI capability in professions like computer, math, business, and finance, with over 90% potential. Observed AI usage is significant in these areas too, indicating a strong displacement risk. Other sectors like transportation and agriculture have lower theoretical AI coverage, suggesting less AI penetration potential.
sentiment_reason: The report indicates a high risk of AI displacement in certain professions due to both high theoretical capability and observed AI usage, reflecting negative market impacts due to potential job displacement.
